content.value: Given $A = { \binom { 0 } { 2 } } \quad { \binom { - 2 } { 3 } }$ , reduce it as a product of elementary matrices. Identify the type of (17) [CO4] each elementary matrix obtained from A (scaling, shear, rotation, etc.), and then apply these transformations sequentially to the line joining the point (1,1) and (3,3) illustrating each step graphically.
